import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
macro=get_index_daily_data('DXY',days=3000)
print('macro', None if macro is None else len(macro))
prices={s:get_index_daily_data(s,days=3000) for s in U}
# date-aligned beta to DXY; factor is negative beta (assets benefiting when DXY weak)
px=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in prices.items() if d is not None}).sort_index()
dx=macro.set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() if macro is not None else None
r=np.log(px).diff(); mr=np.log(dx).diff().reindex(r.index)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(mr).div(mr.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var(),axis=0)
f=-beta
# forward returns and daily IC, horizons
for h in [1,5,10]:
  fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1
  vals=[]
  for dt in f.index:
    a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]))
  z=pd.Series(vals)
  print('H',h,'n',len(z),'mean',z.mean(),'std',z.std(),'icir',z.mean()/z.std(),'hit',(z>0).mean())
# regimes daily by year
fr=px.shift(-1)/px-1
out=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(a)>=8: out.append((dt,a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]),len(a)))
z=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('years',z.groupby(z.index.year).ic.agg(['mean','count']))
print('coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'dates',len(z),'avg names',z.n.mean())
print('turn',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
# correlation with persisted signal-like factors not available; save signal artifact
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20260730_dxy_beta_signal.csv')

macro=get_index_daily_data('DXY',days=3000)
prices={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000) for s in U}
print('macro',len(macro),'assets',sum(x is not None for x in prices.values()))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in prices.items() if d is not None}).sort_index()
dx=macro.set_index('date')['close'].sort_index(); r=np.log(px).diff(); mr=np.log(dx).diff().reindex(r.index)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(mr).div(mr.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var(),axis=0); f=-beta
for h in [1,5,10]:
 fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]))
 z=pd.Series(vals); print('H',h,'n',len(z),'mean',z.mean(),'std',z.std(),'icir',z.mean()/z.std(),'hit',(z>0).mean())
fr=px.shift(-1)/px-1; out=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(a)>=8: out.append((dt,a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]),len(a)))
z=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); print('years',z.groupby(z.index.year).ic.agg(['mean','count']))
print('coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'dates',len(z),'avg names',z.n.mean(),'turn',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20260730_dxy_beta_signal.csv')
